title: 11 overlapping status labels with no glossary — `EvidenceTable.jsx` renders draft/submitted/pending/pending_review/pending_confirmation/under_review/approved/active/closed/rejected/archived; `approved` and `active` look identical
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceTable.jsx` — status badge renderer
**Root Cause:** The status renderer handles 11 distinct status values with no tooltip descriptions, no visual differentiation between `approved` and `active`, and no lifecycle diagram. Users and auditors cannot determine what state an evidence item is in or what action is needed next.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceTable.jsx

1. Create STATUS_CONFIG object:
   { draft: { label: 'Draft', color: 'gray', description: 'Not yet submitted for review', next: ['submitted'] },
     approved: { label: 'Approved', color: 'green', icon: CheckIcon, description: 'Formally approved by reviewer' },
     active: { label: 'Active', color: 'blue', icon: CircleIcon, description: 'In active use and linked to controls' }, ... }
2. Wrap each badge in <Tooltip content={STATUS_CONFIG[status].description}>.
3. Add an Info icon next to the Status column header that opens a Status Lifecycle modal with the full workflow diagram.
4. Consolidate pending/pending_review/pending_confirmation into pending with a substatus field if possible.
```

title: No evidence completeness indicator per item — `EvidenceCard.jsx`/`EvidenceTable.jsx` show no indicator of: files attached / expiry set / control mapping present / reviewer assigned
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceCard.jsx`, `EvidenceTable.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Neither component computes or displays a completeness percentage. The four completeness dimensions (files attached, expiry date set, control mapping present, reviewer assigned) are stored on the evidence record but never aggregated into a visible indicator.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
1. Create helper: computeEvidenceCompleteness(evidence) => { score: 0-100, missing: string[] }
   +25 for evidence.files.length > 0
   +25 for evidence.expirationDate is set
   +25 for evidence.controlMappings.length > 0
   +25 for evidence.assignedReviewerId is set

2. EvidenceCard.jsx: render circular progress indicator with the score.
   If missing.length > 0: show tooltip listing missing items.

3. EvidenceTable.jsx: add "Complete" column with colored dot:
   red <50%, yellow 50–74%, green ≥75%

4. Add bulk filter: "Show incomplete evidence only" in the filter bar.
```

title: Framework coverage formula undisclosed on CoverageScoreCard — percentage shown with no formula explanation; unclear if pending mappings count, one evidence covers multiple controls, or non-applicable controls excluded
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/CoverageScoreCard.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The scorecard renders a percentage with no breakdown of how it is calculated — denominator, whether pending mappings count, and whether non-applicable controls are excluded are all unknown to the user.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/CoverageScoreCard.jsx

1. Add an Info icon that opens a popover with formula:
   "Coverage = Active/Approved mapped controls ÷ Applicable controls × 100"
2. Show breakdown: "47 of 70 applicable controls covered"
3. Add second line: "Pending approval: 8 mappings"
4. Link to "View uncovered controls" filtering ControlMappingContent.
5. Backend coverage endpoint: return { covered, applicable, pending, formula: string }.
```

title: No mapping history on approved control mappings — Approved Mappings tab shows no record of who approved, when, or what comment was provided; violates ISO 19011:2018 §6.4; A.5.33
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/ControlMappingTable.jsx` — Approved Mappings tab
**Root Cause:** Approved mappings are displayed as a list with control names but no record of who approved, when, and with what comment. `WorkflowEntry` documents exist in the backend for these transitions but are never fetched or displayed.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
1. Backend: add GET /evidence/:evidenceId/mappings/:mappingId/history
   Returns WorkflowEntry documents filtered by targetId = mappingId, sorted by createdAt desc.

2. Frontend ControlMappingTable.jsx: add "History" side panel that opens when a mapping row is clicked.
   Render timeline: Actor avatar + name + role | Action | From/To status | Timestamp | Comment.

3. Show "Approved by [name] on [date]: [comment]" in the mapping row as a secondary line.
```

title: Removing a control mapping has no confirmation dialog or reason capture — `ControlMappingTable.jsx` Remove button calls `onRemoveMapping` directly with no AlertDialog or reason field; violates A.5.33
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/ControlMappingTable.jsx` — Remove button
**Root Cause:** The Remove button calls `onRemoveMapping(mappingId)` directly with no AlertDialog confirmation and no reason field. Removing a control mapping reduces compliance coverage and should require documented justification under A.5.33.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/ControlMappingTable.jsx

1. Replace direct Remove onClick with: () => setRemoveTarget(mappingId)
2. Add AlertDialog:
   <AlertDialog open={!!removeTarget} onClose={() => setRemoveTarget(null)}>
     <Textarea placeholder="Reason for removal (min 20 chars)" value={reason} onChange={...} />
     <Button disabled={reason.trim().length < 20} onClick={confirmRemove}>Confirm Remove</Button>
   </AlertDialog>
3. In confirmRemove: call onRemoveMapping(removeTarget, reason.trim())
4. Backend DELETE endpoint: add reason: Joi.string().min(20).required() and store in WorkflowEntry.
```

title: Same user can map evidence and approve the same mapping — no self-review prevention in `ControlMappingContent.jsx`; user with `evidence.write` + `evidence.approve` can create and immediately approve; violates A.5.3
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/ControlMappingContent.jsx`; backend mapping approval endpoint
**Root Cause:** No check prevents the mapping creator from also being the approver. A user with both `evidence.write` and `evidence.approve` can create and immediately approve their own mapping, violating ISO 27001:2022 Annex A.5.3 (Segregation of Duties).
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
Backend — mapping approval endpoint:
1. Add: if (mapping.createdBy === req.user.id)
         return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Conflict of interest: cannot approve your own mapping' });

Frontend — ControlMappingContent.jsx:
2. If currentUser.id === mapping.createdBy, disable the Approve button:
   <Button disabled tooltip="Cannot approve your own mapping">Approve</Button>
3. Show assignable reviewers picker that excludes the mapping creator.
```

title: Evidence requests hardcoded at limit 50 with no pagination — `limit: 50` in `useEvidenceRequests.js`; audit programmes with >50 requests silently drop items; violates Clause 9.2
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/hooks/useEvidenceRequests.js`
**Root Cause:** The `limit: 50` hardcode means any audit programme with more than 50 outstanding requests silently drops all items beyond position 50. There is no pagination UI and no total-count indicator.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
1. useEvidenceRequests.js: add page and pageSize params, remove hardcoded limit: 50.
2. EvidenceRequestsContent.jsx: add <Pagination page={page} total={total} onChange={setPage} />.
3. Display: "Showing {start}–{end} of {total} requests".
4. Backend endpoint: ensure proper skip + limit pagination is implemented and returns { items, total }.
```

title: No escalation or automated reminder for overdue evidence requests — no overdue indicator, days-overdue counter, or Send Reminder button; requires EM-006 (dueDate) fix first; violates Clause 9.2
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceRequestsContent.jsx`; backend scheduled jobs
**Root Cause:** After EM-006 is fixed (adding dueDate), no overdue indicator, days-overdue counter, reminder button, or automated escalation job exists. Overdue requests are visually indistinguishable from on-time ones.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
(Requires EM-006 dueDate fix first)

Frontend — EvidenceRequestsContent.jsx:
1. const isOverdue = req.dueDate && new Date() > new Date(req.dueDate) && req.status !== 'fulfilled';
2. Render <Badge color="red">Overdue — {daysOverdue}d</Badge> on overdue rows.
3. Add "Send Reminder" button: calls POST /evidence-requests/:id/remind.

Backend — scheduled job:
4. Add nightly job: query requests where dueDate < now AND status != fulfilled.
5. Send reminder email to assignee; CC evidence manager after 3+ days overdue.
```

title: Needs Revision state has no structured re-submission checklist — `EvidenceMyReviewsTab.jsx` sends free-text comment only; no checklist of deficiency types; violates ISO 19011:2018 §6.5.4
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceMyReviewsTab.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The Needs Revision flow accepts only free-text comment, giving the submitter vague guidance. Without a structured checklist, submitters frequently resubmit non-conforming evidence because they did not understand what specifically needed to change.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: EvidenceMyReviewsTab.jsx — Needs Revision dialog

1. Add multi-select checklist of deficiency types:
   ['Files missing or wrong format', 'Evidence expired or expiry date missing',
    'Wrong control mapped', 'Insufficient detail in description',
    'Needs legal/compliance sign-off', 'Other']
2. Require at least one selection: if (deficiencies.length === 0) { setError('Select at least one issue'); return; }
3. Pass deficiencies: string[] to the review submission API.
4. EvidenceDetailPage.jsx: display the deficiency checklist from the latest revision request.
```

title: Closed review history has no date-range or text search — no filter in `EvidenceMyReviewsTab.jsx`; reviewers cannot locate a specific prior approval for Stage 2 audit evidence; violates ISO 19011:2018 §6.7
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceMyReviewsTab.jsx` — closed reviews tab
**Root Cause:** The closed reviews list has no search or filter capability. Reviewers processing hundreds of review decisions over months cannot locate a specific approval to reference during audit interviews.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: EvidenceMyReviewsTab.jsx — closed reviews tab

1. Add above the list: date-range picker (from/to), text search input, status filter (approved/rejected/revised).
2. Pass as query params: GET /evidence/reviews?startDate=&endDate=&search=&status=&limit=20&page=
3. Backend: add these filters to the reviews list endpoint with Mongoose query conditions.
```

title: No cryptographic hash displayed per evidence version — SHA-256 stored in S3 metadata but never surfaced in `EvidenceVersionsContent.jsx` / `VersionTimeline.jsx`; auditors cannot verify file integrity; violates A.5.33; Clause 7.5.3
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceVersionsContent.jsx`, `VersionTimeline.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The S3 upload pipeline computes and stores a SHA-256 hash in S3 object metadata, but neither component fetches or displays it. Auditors requesting chain-of-custody verification cannot verify file integrity from the UI.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
Backend — evidence version endpoint:
1. Include sha256Hash in version response: fetch from S3 via s3.headObject({ Bucket, Key }).Metadata.sha256.

Frontend — EvidenceVersionsContent.jsx:
2. Add "SHA-256" column to the version table.
3. Render as monospace truncated string with copy-to-clipboard button.
4. Tooltip: "SHA-256 computed at upload. Compare with your local file hash to verify integrity."

Frontend — VersionTimeline.jsx:
5. Show hash alongside version timestamp.
```

title: Version diff compares metadata only — file content changes invisible; `FileComparisonTable.jsx` compares fields not file bytes; swapped file attachment shows no change in diff view; violates Clause 7.5.3
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/FileComparisonTable.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `FileComparisonTable.jsx` shows field-level diff for metadata (title, description, tags, status) but never compares the actual files between versions. A file-swap attack (replacing an approved PDF with different content while keeping identical metadata) would appear as "no changes" in the diff.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: FileComparisonTable.jsx

1. Add a "Files" section to the diff output.
2. For each file in versionA.files and versionB.files, compare: filename, fileSize, mimeType, sha256Hash.
3. If sha256Hash differs: render prominent warning <Alert variant="destructive">File content changed — this is a different file.</Alert>
4. Backend version comparison endpoint: include file-level metadata (name, size, mime, sha256) in both version snapshots.
```

title: Analytics silently capped at 500 items — `getEvidenceList({ limit: 500 })` in `AnalyticsContent.jsx`; projects with >500 items produce silently incorrect metrics; violates Clause 9.1
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AnalyticsContent.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `AnalyticsContent.jsx` calls `getEvidenceList({ limit: 500 })` and `getMappings({ limit: 500 })` to compute analytics client-side. For organizations with >500 items, metrics are silently incorrect — the cap is a holdover from a development-time optimization never replaced with server-side aggregation.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
1. Create backend endpoint: GET /evidence/analytics/summary
   Returns server-side MongoDB aggregation: total by status, coverage %, avg review time, framework breakdown.
   Never paginates — returns aggregate numbers only.

2. AnalyticsContent.jsx: replace getEvidenceList({limit:500}) and getMappings({limit:500}) calls
   with a single GET /evidence/analytics/summary call.

3. Remove all client-side aggregation loops.
```

title: Average review time uses `createdAt→updatedAt` gap, not actual review duration — `updatedAt` changes on every edit, inflating reported review time; violates Clause 9.1
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AnalyticsContent.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `updatedAt` changes on every edit to an evidence record. Calculating review time as `updatedAt - createdAt` inflates the metric significantly for evidence items edited multiple times before review, making the reported average meaningless.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
Backend — evidence schema:
1. Add: submittedAt: Date (set when status → 'submitted')
2. Add: reviewedAt: Date (set when status → 'approved' or 'rejected')

Backend — analytics endpoint:
3. Compute: AVG(reviewedAt - submittedAt) for items where both timestamps exist.

Frontend — AnalyticsContent.jsx:
4. Use server-computed metric from GET /evidence/analytics/summary.
5. Backfill submittedAt/reviewedAt from WorkflowEntry records for existing evidence items (one-time migration).
```

title: Framework coverage formula inflated by non-applicable controls — denominator = total mapping count including non-applicable; violates ISO 27001:2022 Clause 6.1.3; Annex A SoA requirements
requirement: ISO 27001:2022 Clause 6.1.3; ISO 27001 Annex A SoA requirements
description:
**Files:** Backend coverage calculation service; `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/CoverageScoreCard.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The coverage percentage divides mapped controls by all framework controls including those marked "Not Applicable" in the Statement of Applicability (SoA). Non-applicable controls should be excluded from the denominator, but their inclusion deflates the coverage score and misrepresents compliance posture. This violates ISO 27001:2022 Clause 6.1.3 SoA requirements.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
Backend — coverage calculation service:
1. Accept organizationId param.
2. Query the SoA service (or a local notApplicable field on control-mappings model) for excluded controls.
3. Filter denominator: applicableControls = allControls.filter(c => !soaExclusions.includes(c.id))
4. Return { covered, applicable, notApplicable, formula: string } from the coverage endpoint.

Frontend — CoverageScoreCard.jsx:
5. Show: "67% (47/70 applicable controls)"
6. Add line: "12 controls marked Not Applicable per SoA"
```

title: No drill-down navigation from analytics charts to underlying evidence — framework progress bars, pending count badges non-clickable; auditors cannot navigate from 67% coverage to the gap list; violates Clause 9.1
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AnalyticsContent.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Framework coverage bars and status count badges are static visual elements with no navigation. Clicking "ISO 27001:2022 — 67%" or "Pending: 12" does nothing. Auditors cannot navigate from a gap indicator to the actual list of uncovered controls or pending items.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: AnalyticsContent.jsx

1. Wrap framework coverage bars in <Link href={`/evidence/coverage?framework=${frameworkId}&filter=uncovered`}>.
2. Wrap status badges in <Link href={`/evidence?status=${status}`}>.
3. ControlMappingContent.jsx: add URL param reader that pre-filters by framework + coverage status.
4. EvidenceManagementContent.jsx: add URL param reader that pre-filters by status.
```

title: Auto-collector connection test has no timestamp — status badge shows testing/connected/failed with no indication of when last tested; connected status from 6 months ago indistinguishable; violates A.8.8
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AutoCollectorsContent.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The connector status badge shows `connected`/`testing`/`failed` from the last connection test but displays no timestamp. A connector tested 6 months ago showing `connected` is indistinguishable from one tested 5 minutes ago, giving false confidence about data collection reliability.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
Backend — connector model:
1. Add: lastTestedAt: Date (updated on every connection test).

Frontend — AutoCollectorsContent.jsx:
2. Display "Last tested: {formatRelative(lastTestedAt)}" below the status badge.
3. Add staleness warning: if lastTestedAt > 30 days: <Badge color="yellow">Stale — re-test recommended</Badge>
4. Connection test button: optimistically update lastTestedAt in UI; confirm after API response.
```

title: No last-collection timestamp per connector card — connected connector with no recent collection shows `connected` with no staleness indication; violates A.8.8
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AutoCollectorsContent.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The connector cards show connection status but not when the connector last successfully collected evidence. A connected but silently failing connector (expired API token, stuck job) is visually identical to one that collected successfully 5 minutes ago.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
Backend — connector model:
1. Add: lastCollectedAt: Date (updated when a collection job completes successfully).

Frontend — AutoCollectorsContent.jsx:
2. Display "Last collected: {formatRelative(lastCollectedAt)}" below status.
3. Staleness indicators:
   > 7 days → yellow warning
   > 30 days → red alert with re-trigger button
4. Link the alert to collection job logs.
```

title: Integration evidence filter operates on first 20 API results only — `IntegrationEvidenceListPage.jsx` fetches `limit: 20` then filters client-side; searching Okta username returns no result if not in first 20; violates Clause 9.1
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/IntegrationEvidenceListPage.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `IntegrationEvidenceListPage.jsx` fetches `limit: 20` and then filters client-side. Any item beyond position 20 in the API response is never searched, producing false-negative search results for specific Okta usernames, GitHub commits, or Jira ticket IDs.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
1. Remove client-side filtering from IntegrationEvidenceListPage.jsx.
2. Backend: add search, limit, page query params to the integration evidence endpoint.
3. Frontend: pass search term to API:
   GET /evidence/integration?search=${searchTerm}&limit=50&page=${page}
4. Implement server-side text search using MongoDB $text index on title, description, sourceId.
5. Add pagination controls and total count display.
```

title: Recent Exports shows hardcoded static data when API unavailable — `staticRecentExports` in `ExportShareContent.jsx` contains entries dated 2025-12-28 presented as genuine export history; fabricated records; violates Clause 7.5; A.5.36
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/ExportShareContent.jsx` — `staticRecentExports`
**Root Cause:** A `staticRecentExports` array hardcoded with dates `2025-12-25`, `2025-12-26`, `2025-12-28` is rendered in the "Recent Exports" section when the real API call fails or is absent. This presents fabricated export records as genuine compliance history, violating Clause 7.5 (document control integrity) and A.5.36.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: ExportShareContent.jsx

1. Delete the staticRecentExports array entirely (remove all lines referencing it).
2. Replace with:
   if (exports.length === 0) return <EmptyState title="No exports yet" description="Export history will appear here." />;
3. Implement backend: GET /evidence/export/history returns real export records (empty array on first use).
4. Fetch on mount; show loading spinner while fetching; empty state if array is empty.
```

title: No evidence scope selection before export — no filter for categories, frameworks, date range, or status to include; every export appears to export the entire repository; violates Clause 7.5.3
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/ExportShareContent.jsx`
**Root Cause:** The export UI presents format options (ZIP, PDF, CSV) but no scope filter. All exports implicitly include the entire evidence repository. An auditor cannot generate a scoped package for a specific control family, framework section, or date range.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: ExportShareContent.jsx

1. Add a "Define Scope" step before format selection:
   - Framework multi-select
   - Control family
   - Status filter (approved only / all)
   - Date range (evidence created/approved between)
2. Show preview: "This export will include N evidence items across M controls."
3. Pass scope as query params to the backend export endpoint.
4. Backend: filter evidence dataset by scope before generating ZIP/PDF.
```

title: Split-Files action captures no reason — `handleSplitFiles` creates new evidence record with no reason field; neither original nor new record has documented rationale for split; violates ISO 19011:2018 §6.4; A.5.33
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceManagementContent.jsx` — `handleSplitFiles`
**Root Cause:** `handleSplitFiles` creates a new evidence record and moves selected files to it without capturing a reason for the split. Both the source and destination records lack documented rationale in the audit trail, violating A.5.33 requirements for documented modification justification.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: EvidenceManagementContent.jsx — handleSplitFiles

1. Before executing split, open AlertDialog with required Textarea:
   "Reason for splitting these files (min 30 chars)"
2. Validate: if (reason.trim().length < 30) return.
3. Pass reason to POST /evidence/:id/split as required body field.
4. Backend: add reason: Joi.string().min(30).required() to split endpoint.
5. Create WorkflowEntry for both source and target evidence documenting: actor, timestamp, reason, files moved.
```

title: Evidence version linked in mapping never shown to user — `evidenceVersion` prop sent to backend in `MapControlModal.jsx` but never displayed; users unknowingly map a superseded evidence version; violates Clause 7.5.3
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/MapControlModal.jsx`, `ControlMappingTable.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `MapControlModal.jsx` passes `evidenceVersion` to the backend when creating a mapping, binding it to a specific version. However, this version is never displayed in the mapping list or approval UI. Approvers see the latest evidence version, not the version the mapping was created against, which may be superseded.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
MapControlModal.jsx:
1. Display the version being mapped: "Mapping evidence version: EV-2025-0042 (v3 — active)"
2. If not the latest: <Alert>⚠ You are mapping against v3 but v5 is the latest. Consider remapping.</Alert>

ControlMappingTable.jsx:
3. In each mapping row, show: "Evidence v3 (of v5)" as a secondary line.
4. Backend mapping list endpoint: return evidenceVersion and latestVersion per mapping.
```
